title: Teams stuck on sign-in spinner after correct password entry
symptoms: Teams desktop app loops on a loading/spinner screen after login, never reaches the main interface
resolution:
1. Fully sign out and clear the Teams cache folder before relaunching
2. Update Teams to the latest version
3. Reinstall the Teams desktop client if cache clearing doesn't resolve it

title: Scheduled meetings not appearing in Teams calendar
symptoms: Meetings visible in Outlook calendar do not show up in the Teams calendar tab
resolution:
1. Force a manual sync by signing out and back into Teams
2. Confirm the same account/mailbox is used for both Outlook and Teams
3. Check for a delayed calendar sync (can take up to a few hours) before escalating

title: Camera or microphone not detected in Teams meetings
symptoms: Teams shows 'no camera found' or 'no microphone found' even though the device works in other apps
resolution:
1. Check Teams app permissions for camera/microphone access in device privacy settings
2. Close other apps that may be holding the camera/mic (e.g. Zoom, browser tabs)
3. Restart Teams after adjusting permissions; reinstall if device still isn't detected

title: Cannot join or create Teams channels for a course/team
symptoms: User is unable to see or join a specific Team/channel they expect access to
resolution:
1. Confirm the user is on the correct roster/enrollment list for that Team
2. Ask the Team owner to verify and resend the invite if membership is confirmed
3. Have the user leave and rejoin the Team using the invite link

title: Screen share not working during a call
symptoms: Screen share button is greyed out or shared screen appears black to other participants
resolution:
1. Grant Teams screen recording permission in device system settings (common on macOS)
2. Update Teams and graphics drivers to latest versions
3. Restart Teams and retry sharing a single application window instead of full screen

title: Teams notifications not appearing despite settings enabled
symptoms: No desktop/mobile notifications for chats or mentions even though notification settings look correct
resolution:
1. Check OS-level notification permissions for the Teams app, not just in-app settings
2. Confirm 'Do not disturb' or focus mode isn't active on the device
3. Sign out and back into Teams to refresh the notification service registration

title: Teams login fails while other Microsoft apps work fine
symptoms: Outlook, portal, and other services log in normally, but Teams specifically rejects the same credentials
resolution:
1. Clear Teams' local cache/credential cache folder completely
2. Confirm the account has an active Teams license assigned
3. Try Teams on the web (teams.microsoft.com) to isolate whether the issue is app-specific or account-wide
